app.notes:
The guide melody now follows the MELODY setting on every song, including the many that reset their sound at the start
Muted parts in the Mixer stay muted for the whole song
The equalizer now changes the sound of MIDI songs too, not just MP3s and videos
Moving one equalizer bar no longer makes another one jump back
The Guide melody and master volume sliders change the sound as you drag them
